verdict.rationale: llamafile runs models entirely on the user's own device with no cloud and no outbound network, so data stays wherever the user chooses to run it, which effectively gives the user control over residency. Hands-on reports corroborate that it runs with zero network connection. However, there is no explicit region or residency selection feature or documentation, and residency control comes only from on-device execution. Missing for 10: explicit documented data-residency or storage-location controls, documentation of where local data such as uploads, logs, or caches are written and how to configure that path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Models run entirely on your device. No cloud, no data sharing, no external dependencies.
Run local LLMs privately, offline, and with full control over compute, data, and cost.
No outbound network. `anet` allows `accept()` but not `connect()`, so the only networking the server can do is answer connections it received.
It appears to execute with zero network connection
